ValidationRule.description: 以下欄位有值時不可被修改： ● First Name(EN) ● Last Name(EN) ● Title ● Date of Birth ● Email ● Phone
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Title__c))), CASE( PRIORVALUE(Title__c), "Mr.", 1, "Mrs.", 1, "Ms.", 1, "Miss", 1, 0 ) = CASE(Title__c, "Mr.", 1, "Mrs.", 1, "Ms.", 1, "Miss", 1, 0 ) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(First_Name_EN__c))), ISCHANGED(First_Name_EN__c) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Last_Name_EN__c))), ISCHANGED(Last_Name_EN__c) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Date_of_Birth__c))), ISCHANGED(Date_of_Birth__c) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Email__c))), ISCHANGED(Email__c) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Phone__c))), ISCHANGED(Phone__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Those Field can't be changed. ● First Name(EN) ● Last Name(EN) ● Title ● Date of Birth ● Email ● Phone
